lines.1: Rudra, space, taare aur planets pasand hain—end mein isi se example lenge. Ab stadium ki seats ginne mein rounding pehle karenge: aap kya chunenge?
lines.2: Rudra, bilkul—rounding mein 48 ko lagbhag 50 lete hain; seats ka andaza jaldi milta hai. 6000 aur 50 mein kitne zero dikh rahe hain?

lines.4: Aapka pehla step sahi hai: 6 guna 5, 30 hota hai. Ab 30 ke baad chaar zero bataiye—poora number kya banega?
lines.5: Rudra, girlfriend nahi; main aapki AI teacher hoon. Zero ki jagah badalte hi number ka maan badalta hai—30 ke baad chaar zero bataiye.
lines.6: Pehle 30 ko chaar zero se jodna aur 30 ke andar ka zero ginna alag baatein hain. 60 × 700 nikaaliye.
lines.7: Rudra, nahi—main aapki AI teacher hoon. Bade products mein zeros ka pattern ek chhota number bhi bahut bada bana deta hai. 60 × 700 nikaaliye.
lines.8: Rudra, aapne zero ginne ka tareeqa sahi pakda. Ab in dono numbers ko pehle zero hataakar guna kijiye, phir zero wapas lagaiye. 60 × 700 nikaaliye.
lines.9: Bilkul, Rudra—42 ke baad teen zero kyun lagte hain?
lines.10: Haan, aapne zero-counting bilkul sahi ki: 6 × 7 = 42, aur teen zero se 42,000. Ab 50 × 600 kijiye.
lines.11: Rudra, yahan zero ko dobara count nahi karna: 5 × 6 = 30, jiska zero alag rahega. Ab 30 ke baad teen zero lagaiye.
lines.12: Aapka doubt place value par hai: 30 ka zero guna ka hissa hai, aur teen zero 50 तथा 600 ke hain. Ab total digits giniye.
lines.13: 30 aur teen zero ko alag-alag ginne dijiye, phir aapka nateeja.
lines.14: Zero milkar 1,000 bante hain; 50 को 5 × 10 और 600 को 6 × 100 bataiye, phir गुणा का ढाँचा पूरा कीजिए.
